evidence.note: Hand reaches the refrigerator door edge to open it.
Door is fully open and illuminated interior is visible.
Hand is pulling the open refrigerator door toward the frame.
Both doors of the upper cabinet over the cooktop are closed.
The first cabinet-door leaf is visibly open, exposing the shelf.
Both cabinet-door leaves remain open immediately before closure.
Hand finishes closing the cabinet; all upper wood panels are flush.

events.object_description: Upper cabinet over the cooktop/hood, first-opened door leaf

evidence.note: One cabinet leaf is already open while the second leaf is being manipulated.
Both distinct cabinet-door leaves are open.
Both leaves are still open just before they are closed.
Both cabinet leaves are closed; their individual closing instants fall between samples.

events.object_description: Upper cabinet over the cooktop/hood, second-opened door leaf

evidence.note: Hand reaches the handle of the top drawer beside the range.
Top drawer is pulled open, exposing stored items.
Hand pushes the open drawer inward.
Drawer front is flush with the cabinet again.

events.object_description: Top pull-out drawer immediately right of the range

notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. The two independently hinged upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately. Both close within the same 592–600 sampling interval, so their individual off-transition ordering cannot be resolved.
scene_description: A user moves through a compact kitchen and manipulates the refrigerator door, two separate hinged leaves of the upper cabinet above the cooktop/hood, and the top drawer beside the range.
